name: 05001 · White Riv Jct, VT
findings: ZIP 05001 (White Riv Jct) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05001 (White Riv Jct) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 05001 (White Riv Jct) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
